{{Top|leg}}
'''Polonium''' was an element that was [[Mining/Legends|mined]]. Polonium was used with [[Uranium/Legends|uranium]] in the [[UP236-TDC]] explosive. The [[uranium/polonium-236 tactical demolition charge]] used a small disc of enriched uranium and a wedge of polonium surrounded by high-yield shape charges that were designed to induce [[nuclear fusion]] through kinetic force.
